thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency breach detected for /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-2. Current p99=3.2s (SLO p99=1.1s). Triggering pager to eng-oncall and runtime.
Ryan (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Any initial customer impact? :eyes:
Mira (sre): looking at batcher dashboards — cont-batch path is creating very large packs because of mixed sequence lengths (lots of short requests coalesced with few very long ones). Pack size spikes to 120+ and pack_time spikes -> KV paging on GPUs.
Shefali (runtime): confirmed from runtime traces. Streaming-forward loop stalls when a huge pack causes KV cache thrash then gpu paging. Seen repeated stalls on the streaming worker threads.
Mira (sre): snippets from logs:
```
[TASK] worker=streamer-42 pack_size=138 avg_seqlen=18 max_seqlen=4096 kv_evictions=23 gpu_page_faults=18 pack_time_ms=1280 tail_lat_ms=3200
[TASK] worker=streamer-42 trace_id=abc123 stall=1 stall_reason=kv_paging
```
Ryan (oncall): oof. What's the quick mitigation? Can we reduce pack sizes for streaming only?
Shefali (runtime): immediate mitigations we can push now:
- limit streaming max_pack_size 64 -> 16
- lower pack_timeout from 50ms -> 10ms for stream path (avoid waiting to accumulate mixed short requests)
- enable preemptive scheduling so long sequences don't block short ones (sched_weight_short=2, long=1)
I can push the config to us-west-2 staging -> prod within minutes.
Mira (sre): customer-impact assessment: about 0.9% of streaming requests experienced stalls >5s in the last 10m. Top affected tenants: searchX-prod (high volume streaming queries) and convoLabs (long-context sessions). No 5xx surge, but many clients hit application-level timeouts.
ops-bot: Created INC-2026-4321 and linked alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-2026-4321
Ryan (oncall): prioritize searchX-prod. Lina (CS) can you start outreach? @Customer Success (Lina)
Customer Success (Lina): pinged searchX and convoLabs with initial note, offering status and mitigation ETA.
Shefali (runtime): rolling change now — patch applied to runtime-config streaming profile in us-west-2:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  streaming.max_pack_size: "16"
  streaming.pack_timeout_ms: "10"
  scheduler.preemptive: "true"
  scheduler.weights: "short=2,long=1"
```
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n inference --patch "..." --context=us-west-2
platform-automation: rolling restart started for streamer pools in us-west-2 (5 nodes at a time).
Mira (sre): monitoring p95/p99 now. Also enabling an emergency fallback route to dedicated pool 'dedicated-stream-fallback' for heavy sessions so they don't contend with the shared cont-batch pool.
Ryan (oncall): applied fallback route for requests with header X-Session-Heavy:true -> dedicated-stream-fallback. Command: `routectl add-rule --match header:X-Session-Heavy:true --dest dedicated-stream-fallback`
Shefali (runtime): observed telemetry 4 minutes after change: p95 reduced to ~0.9s (from 1.6s), p99 now ~1.4s (from 3.2s). Pack sizes for streaming path now centered ~10-18. KV page faults reduced.
Mira (sre): partial success. p99 still slightly above target in the next 10m burst window — likely residual long-context requests still coalescing before preemption fully stabilizes.
Ryan (oncall): next step: enable aggressive KV eviction for contexts >1024 tokens to reduce thrash and set a soft cap on packable max_seqlen for streaming pool to 2048. Shefali, can you push?
Shefali (runtime): pushing kv_evict config and max_seqlen cap now.
```
runtime.kv_evict.threshold_tokens=1024
streaming.max_packable_seqlen=2048
```
Shefali (runtime): done. Rolling to nodes.
Mira (sre): metrics look better — p99 down to 0.98s at 12m post-change. Streaming stalls >5s dropped from 0.9% to 0.04%. Customer complaints still coming in but far fewer.
Ryan (oncall): great. Status: incident mitigated for now. Escalation: low customer-impact active, but SLO was breached; we need a follow-up RCA.
Mira (sre): adding notes to INC-2026-4321: timeline, config diffs, metrics baseline, affected tenants, temporary routing and pack limits applied. Proposed RCA action items:
- instrument packer to expose per-pack seqlen distribution and per-tenant pack latency
- scheduler fairness rewrite to prefer small seqs for streaming by default
- add chaos tests with heterogeneous seqlen workloads to CI
- consider adaptive pack sizing that is context-aware
Ryan (oncall): agree. Also recommend we create a canary that applies new pack_timeout and preemptive scheduling on a small subset of nodes for a week before global rollout.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4321 updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
Ryan (oncall): handing off to next oncall, Sam, for post-mit follow-up and customer reopen triage at 04:00 UTC. Key links:
- Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/contbatch/streaming-usw2
- Traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123
- Incident: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-2026-4321
Sam (oncall-next): ack, will pick this up. Please add any follow-up runbook items here. I'll coordinate the RCA and set a postmortem owner.
Mira (sre): handoff notes: changes made, times, metrics, fallback route, customer notify status. See pinned message.
Ryan (oncall): closing pager for now. If anything regresses, page eng-oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
Shefali (runtime): follow-ups I'll own: add packer telemetry, write preemption unit tests, and draft config for canary rollout. ETA 3 working days.
Customer Success (Lina): continuing outreach and collecting any residual impact reports from affected tenants.
Sam (oncall-next): will add RCA timeline and invite runtime + SRE + CS to the postmortem sync.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4321 status changed: MITIGATED -> MONITORING.
